an7.78:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hoti.
an7.78:1.7: anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an7.78:1.8: dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
an7.78:1.9: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.78:1.10: imehi kho bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hotīti.
